{{Short description|Italian mathematician}}
[[File:Longo_-_Discorso_matematico,_1588_-_119815.jpg|thumb|''Discorso matematico'' (1588)]]

'''Giovanni Lodovico Longo''', also known as '''Gio. Luigi Lungo''' ([[Floruit|fl.]] 1588), was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]].<ref>{{Cite book|title=Archivio biografico italiano|volume=3|location=Munich|publisher=K. G. Saur|date=1987|page=836|isbn=9783598315558|language=it|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=jaAUAQAAMAAJ}}</ref>

Born in [[Piedmont]], he became a citizen of [[Perugia]] and there a member of the Academy of the Senseless (''Accademia degli Insensati''), where he was nicknamed "the Concentrate" (''il Concentrato'').<ref>''Discorso matematico'', [[:File:Longo_-_Discorso_matematico,_1588_-_119815.jpg|title page]].</ref>
